description: Angular component for managing document collaborators, including invitations and online status.

classes.name: DocumentCollaboratorsComponent
classes.description: Angular standalone component for displaying and managing document collaborators, handling invites and online status.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Lifecycle hook for component initialization; intended to handle subscription setup.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Lifecycle hook for cleanup; unsubscribes from online collaborator status updates.

methods.name: onInvite
methods.description: Emits an invite event with the trimmed pending invite input; resets the input field.
